title: Aggregated plugin view (api/v1/plugins/<id>.json)
description: Every provider's latest row for one plugin plus the combined verdict (ADR-0009). Per-provider rows are always present, also when the combined verdict ignores or caps them.

listing.description: The plugin's full store.json row (listing, GitHub activity, ranking factors, README gallery). Present when the aggregator ran with stats + ranking; a client that loaded only the columnar search file reads the full record here (ADR-0032).

weeks.description: Default-branch commits per week, oldest first, last = the current week; null = older than the oldest of the last 100 commits read (unknown).

basis.description: trusted = at least one core/verified row decided it; untrusted = only capped rows (community, unsigned): `safe` is then reported as `unknown`.

contested.description: Trusted rows disagree by two or more levels, or a trusted `safe` meets a capped `risky`/`blocked`.

commits.description: Distinct reviewed commits behind the combined verdict (more than one = rows review different commits).

counted.description: false = shown but not part of the combined verdict (unknown verdict).

detail.description: Source-specific extras. Marketplace: baseline findings + capabilities. Feed rows: scope, method, target and, when the provider embeds it, `report` (the predicate's optional report extension, rule ids opaque).

statement.description: API-relative path of the verified statement (immutable).
